title: Find where a strength works and a limit needs support

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A useful strength/limit comparison keeps a visible task standard and records help. A better result after a support change suggests fit; it does not isolate a cause if other conditions also changed.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Complete text A: “The reading circle meets Tuesday at 16:00 in Room C. Bring a pencil. The previous Room B notice is cancelled.” Target: accurately preserve day/time, current room and required preparation. Text B for another attempt: “The repair discussion meets Thursday at 10:00 in Room F. Read the one-page agenda first. The previous Room E notice is cancelled.” Use an accessible reading mode; no speed target.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Summarize A in three factual points, then use a checklist for B. Keep the two outputs, help used and any context difference before checking.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: Text C: “Map exchange: Friday 12:00, Hall J. Bring nothing; the host supplies paper.” Give the three required points and reject one likely carryover error.

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: A: Tuesday 16:00, Room C, pencil. B: Thursday 10:00, Room F, agenda first. Grouping day/time as one point is allowed. Partial: retain two facts but omit preparation. Incorrect: keep the cancelled room. Later fiction: A omitted preparation, B included all three with the checklist; different text prevents isolating its effect. No aid needs removal to make learning count.
criteria: Superseded or imported details are rejected
Support and context remain in the comparison

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: Friday 12:00; Hall J; no materials required from the participant. A pencil or pre-read agenda requirement imported from A/B is wrong. This checks the new text, not general intelligence.
criteria: Superseded or imported details are rejected
